entries.05fa77f8bf1b3fea: Manufactures and sells precut timber for housing. Produced at its head office plant in Kanuma, Tochigi Prefecture.
entries.18a7007006f5303f: A business in which the company and some of its subsidiaries lease tenant buildings and condominiums they own and operate parking facilities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥461 million.
entries.27a852d74ca06bfb: Sells building materials other than precut timber and housing equipment.
entries.4c1c4a4a4bcd132f: Subsidiary Chūko Jūtaku Jōhōkan Co.,Ltd. sells used homes. The company is also working to strengthen its used home brokerage operations.
entries.6a52460428f414bf: Leases offices, housing and others, including the Utsunomiya Satellite Building.
entries.6cff6f87fd9bc261: A business in which subsidiary Zeneraru Ributekku Co.,Ltd. sells building materials and components, mainly precut timber. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,783 million. It is also working to win orders for multi-unit housing and to expand sales of building materials other than precut timber.
entries.8505e7fa9a715c2e: A company centered on the sale of detached houses in the northern Kanto region and the Tokyo metropolitan area, also handling sales of used houses, renovation, sales of building materials, and real estate leasing.
entries.8c08de7c138c8f1f: Subsidiary Grandy Reform Co.,Ltd. carries out periodic inspections, maintenance and renovation of buildings constructed by the company. The company is also building relationships with customers through its owner membership organization “Smile Club”.
entries.ab3a2d27cea91409: Sales of Building Materials and Housing Equipment
entries.c26158b16bf1c97f: A business in which the group handles everything from purchasing land for development, obtaining development permits, managing residential land development works, and designing and constructing homes, to sales and after-sales maintenance. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥49,735 million, the largest of the three businesses and accounting for most of consolidated revenue. The company is mainly responsible for Tochigi Prefecture, western Ibaraki Prefecture, Saitama Prefecture and Tokyo, while regional subsidiaries are mainly responsible for Ibaraki Prefecture, Gunma Prefecture, Chiba Prefecture and Kanagawa Prefecture.
entries.c2ca4878ce9b44d5: Leasing of Tenant Buildings and Condominiums
entries.c5b76df9efc19860: Sells detached houses for sale, designs and builds custom-built homes, and sells land. The product brand is “Grandy House”. Buildings whose construction starts from May 2025 onward adopt seismic damping dampers as standard, and from November 2025 the company has introduced its “60-year Guarantee and 60-year Support System”.
